authority.title: Autodesk AutoCAD 2021 FIELD (DXF)
supports: Group 97 is the number of object IDs used in field code.
Group 331 repeats for those IDs and is an AcDbSoftPointerId.
Group 330 represents the ID value when the field-value data type is ID.

implementation.admission: hasTableContentFieldOutputProfile permits only string values and resolved type-64 object-ID values for this profile; object-handle lists and keyed child-value object IDs must resolve to a retained document object. Other child-value types remain refused.
implementation.serialization: The existing FIELD serializer remaps group 331 and type-64 group 330 handles through the DXF writer's object-handle remapper.

observations: ASCII and Binary output both read back all three FIELD records, FIELDLIST membership, and TABLECONTENT FIELD references.
Group-331 references and main/child group-330 IDs resolve to the emitted LINE handle, which differs from its source handle.
An unresolved CadValue object ID is refused without replacing a sentinel destination; correcting the reference succeeds on the same adapter instance.
No external DWG/DXF fixture was added.
